character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist throughout the full music video: dark wavy hair tied with a narrow burgundy ribbon, deep green eyes, with a distinct consistent face and adult proportions. Their role is a Venetian gondolier and amateur composer who knows the city's hidden canals. Fixed signature outfit: a cream linen shirt, dark wine-red waistcoat, striped sash, and black gondolier trousers. Defining personal item: a small carved wooden oar charm. Preserve the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: This theme follows one fixed protagonist identity from the opening to the finale.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume silhouette, colors, and defining personal item in every scene.
Do not substitute the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with terracotta, canal green, stone cream, dusk rose; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by low gondola-level shot along a canal, wide shot of a domed basilica across water, slow tracking under stone bridges; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
